explication: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI short-video production application. A user submits a topic through the Streamlit WebUI or FastAPI API; the system generates a script and search terms, gathers or uploads media, synthesizes voice, subtitles, and music, then renders and stores a finished video and task artifacts. Task managers provide bounded asynchronous execution, with Redis as an optional durable queue. The sampled files confirm routing, LLM/provider selection, task orchestration boundaries, Redis serialization, and Seedance polling; several media-stage call sites were not sampled.
